Pack: load 4.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[15,5]]]*/const D={"L_p15":"[[588,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf15\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unchanged since Kamino: from cover Kirishima saw the masked man the League answers to (All For One) strike down the heroes at the Nomu warehouse and warp the League and Katsuki Bakugo to him, and on the broadcast, with the whole country, he saw All Might's hero form give way to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who still won and then retired. He does not know the masked man's name, why All Might's body failed, anything of One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya, unless the story tells him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf15\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[589,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf16\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Izuku's base and Sports Festival notes holds as history. Gran Torino knows One For All and asked for Izuku as an intern to train All Might's choice properly. He taught him to stop treating the power as something special to fire from one limb and to spread it through his whole body: One For All: Full Cowl, which Izuku ran at about five percent all summer. By now All Might has told Izuku about All For One (in canon, after the internships): the villain who steals Quirks and gives them away, whose younger brother was the first holder of One For All, and who killed Nana Shimura and gave All Might his wound. He warned that All For One may be alive and behind the League, and that Izuku may one day have to face him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino All For One appeared in person, and All Might fought him on live broadcast. The whole country watched All Might lose his hero form and fight on as a thin, wounded man; with the last embers of One For All he beat All For One, who is now held in Tartarus, then pointed at the camera: \\\"Next, it's your turn.\\\" The country heard it as a message to everyone; Izuku knows it was meant for him. All Might's power is gone and he has retired. Izuku is now the only holder of One For All, and All Might still coaches him in private.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki Bakugo blames himself for All Might's end, since his own kidnapping led to Kamino. He has begun to put together Izuku's late power, anything Izuku has let slip to him and All Might's message, and suspects All Might gave Izuku his power; he has said nothing, and he learns the truth only if the story brings him to it. What All For One told All Might at Kamino about Tomura Shigaraki's family, Izuku learns only if the story has All Might tell him. Until the story shows otherwise, Izuku holds only about five percent safely, and no earlier holder's Quirk has awakened in him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf16\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[590,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf17\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Izuku's earlier notes holds as history. Izuku is the only holder of One For All; All Might's power is gone, and he coaches Izuku in private. The circle that knows is unchanged, and no classmate knows, unless the story widens it. Until the story shows otherwise, no earlier holder's Quirk has awakened in Izuku, and his safe share is still a small, single-digit percentage, rising only as the story trains him; any share above what his body can hold breaks him, and the doctors' warning about his arms stands.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki Bakugo blames himself for All Might's end, since his kidnapping led to Kamino, and failing the exam Izuku passed has sharpened it. He has put together Izuku's late power, anything Izuku has let slip to him and All Might's message at Kamino, and suspects All Might gave Izuku his power. Whether he forces the truth out of Izuku, and what All Might tells him if he does, follows the story; if he learns it, he keeps it secret.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf17\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[591,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Ochaco Uraraka (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf18\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). The battle at Kamino went out live, and the whole country, Ochaco included, saw All Might's hero form give out mid-fight into a gaunt, wounded man before he won; he retired soon after and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record says only that he retired. She knows what the broadcast showed and nothing more: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, or One For All. The villain he beat there, All For One, the League's backer, is in custody; she knows him only as the villain in the broadcast.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She has no suspicion that Izuku Midoriya's power is linked to All Might, and nothing this summer gave her one. Her worry for Izuku is about how often he breaks himself, never about where his power came from.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf18\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[592,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Ochaco Uraraka (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf19\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). Since the live Kamino broadcast, Ochaco, like the whole country, has seen All Might's hero form give out into a gaunt, wounded man in his last fight; he has retired and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record leaves All Might out. She knows what the broadcast showed and nothing more: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya's power. She knows the villain he beat there (All For One, the League's backer) only as the villain in the broadcast. This holds for the rest of the year unless the story tells her more.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf19\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 4"];})();
